verdict.rationale: Shortwave's AI Assistant acts as an MCP client. Users click "Add custom integration" and point it at any MCP server, including one they built themselves. The pricing page lists MCP alongside built-in integrations, and the blog lists prebuilt connectors such as GitHub and Zapier. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that custom MCP servers work, and detailed setup docs (transport/auth options, tool permissions or approval controls).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: You can connect virtually any application through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Just click "Add custom integration" and point to an MCP server of your choice — or even create your own.
Connect the AI with your favorite apps and services for enhanced productivity workflows through built-in integrations or MCP
AI Integrations for Shortwave—a powerful new feature that connects our AI Assistant to all your business applications
